requirements.summary: Surface unclassified startup failures with a typed error.code, a bounded optional startup_stage and a bounded optional startup_cause emitted as exactly one startup_failed line per failing exit and none on graceful shutdown (nil-preserving wrap); four documented classifications — snapshot_recovery (quarantined-unrecoverable recovery), catalog_loop_start (loop.Start errors that are neither publication failures nor *config.Diagnostics wraps, incl. admission/persist refusal), catalog_loop_drain (drain-budget expiry) and listener_serve (non-ErrServerClosed serve error) — each with a closed startup_cause enum value (snapshot_unrecoverable; admission_persist_failed or generic_loop_start, with publication_wrap_failed documented but intercepted; drain_budget_exceeded; listener_serve_failed) and no raw text; two documented operator-visible compatibility changes: quarantined-unrecoverable snapshot-recovery exits reclassify state_directory→snapshot_recovery (state_directory keeps its meaning for storage.Open failures) and disabled-quarantine loop.Start admission/persist-refusal exits reclassify internal_error→catalog_loop_start (internal_error stays the code for every genuinely unknown startup error, with neither optional key); additive two-field envelope with schema_version 1 preserved and the field union 130→132 in lockstep across envelopeFieldNames, docs/logging-contract.md, internal/observe/log_test.go and the config_envelope_test.go count pin; full-path runContext tests prove one line + code + stage + cause for catalog_loop_start, snapshot_recovery and listener_serve (listener via a release-free serveListenerFn seam whose override closes the named listener and returns the synthetic error immediately, with the served listener's refusal observed after the drain starts and a bounded exit wait instead of a cancel race); the ticket item 1 sanitized cause summary is the class-level static error.remediation plus the closed startup_cause enum; no secrets or raw error text.
